summary: RozumovyiMozok is a dynamic 2D endless runner arcade game built in Unity (C#). In the game, the player pilots a spaceship flying continuously through deep space, dodging incoming asteroids to survive as long as possible and set a high score.   The project addresses the demand for fast-paced, accessible casual games that test player reaction time and focus while maintaining smooth performance. We implemented core arcade mechanics—including vertical impulse controls, dynamic obstacle generation, a scoring system, and persistent high-score tracking via PlayerPrefs—alongside performance optimization using Object Pooling and a modular architecture powered by ScriptableObjects. The game also features a complete UI with a main menu, character skin selection, and pause/game-over screens.   Developed collaboratively via GitHub, this project demonstrates clean game architecture, efficient memory management, and engaging arcade gameplay ready for future expansion into mobile platforms.
details:
Overview & How It Works RozumovyiMozok is a 2D endless runner arcade game set in deep space. The player pilots a spaceship flying continuously forward, using vertical impulses (jumps) along the Y-axis to dodge dynamically generated asteroids. Players earn points for every obstacle passed and aim to beat their high score before colliding with an enemy.

Tools & Technologies

  • Engine & Code: Developed in Unity using C#, with ScriptableObjects for modular parameter configuration.
  • Optimization & UI: Uses Object Pooling for smooth asteroid spawningand PlayerPrefs to save high scores. Includes a Main Menu (Start, Exit, Character skins), Pause, and Game Over screens.
  • Assets & Workflow: Built with 2D sprites, audio samples, Unity’s Particle System, and Git/GitHub for team collaboration.

Creativity, Key Factors & Impact Our team combined classic reaction-based gameplay with a quirky cosmic aesthetic, character skins, and humorous game-over prompts. We prioritized responsive controls and memory optimization to ensure uninterrupted gameplay. The game offers an engaging way to train reaction speed and provides a scalable codebase ready for future updates, including an in-game coin economy and mobile controls.
